sources: Hicks & Leitenberg (2001), Sexual fantasies about one's sexual partner versus someone else: Gender differences in incidence and frequency, Journal of Sex Research 38(1), 43–50 – 349 university students and employees in heterosexual relationships; in the past two months 98% of men and 80% of women reported fantasizing about someone other than their partner at least occasionally.

Gormezano, Kutchko, Chadwick, Burns, Hunker, Konermann & van Anders (2026), Sexual Fantasies Across Solitary and Partnered Contexts, Archives of Sexual Behavior – 546 adults in committed relationships (6+ months): about 38% thought of someone other than their partner during partnered sex; fantasy target not directly tied to relationship satisfaction (cross-sectional; higher sexual satisfaction went with fewer fantasies about others).
